name: rpi5-sensevoice
description: Raspberry Pi 5 (CPU-only): SenseVoice offline ASR (zh/en/ja/ko/yue) via sherpa-onnx OfflineRecognizer.from_sense_voice. ASR-only transcription profile (no TTS) — SenseVoice serves the offline /asr path; streaming Paraformer also loads for /asr/stream. sherpa recognizers are re-entrant across streams, so admitted requests really do run in parallel here; the bound is the board's 4 cores, which is what STREAMING_ASR_NUM_THREADS still sizes. asr_max_slots=8 admits twice the core count so a burst queues in the thread pool instead of taking a 429.
